title: Initialize Core
content:
Bootstrapping a high-concurrency node takes less than 60 seconds. Photon is designed to be lean, powerful, and zero-config.

1. Orchestration

Install the core engine via the Bun package manager:

bun add @gravito/photon

2. Source Entry

Create an index.ts file and define your application logic:

import { Gravito } from '@gravito/photon'

const app = new Gravito()

app.get('/', (c) => {
  return c.json({ 
    status: 'accelerating', 
    version: '1.1.0' 
  })
})

export default {
  port: 3000,
  fetch: app.fetch.bind(app)
}
